audiences.rule: Write for the people who already read and follow: art-school graduates, artists with a day job and independent curators, and more and more people asking what AI changes in art. Young gallerists and first-time collectors read occasionally, and collectors are growing.

notes.text: A curator spent 4 minutes on the walls and 20 on the sketchbooks. Show the process, not only the finished works.
“I priced it by what I would be sad to sell it for.” Best pricing rule I have heard this year.
Hyde's “The Gift”: art lives in two economies at once, the gift and the market. Every young artist is translating between them.
Seven readers asked the same thing under the curating piece: where do you find a first venue? That is the next piece.
The best show this month had no wall texts at all. People talked to each other instead of reading.
Open calls this year: 40 sent, 3 accepted, €1,140 in fees. Half the fees went to calls I was never right for.
A gallerist: “We take 50% because we carry the risk of the next five shows, not this one.” Worth a follow-up.
A piece written as a price list: what a first solo show actually costs, line by line, paid by whom.
A curator on AI: “The machine can sort a thousand portfolios. It cannot sit in a studio and notice what the artist is afraid to show.”
Artist-run spaces close because the founder burns out, not because nobody comes.

profile.name: Nora Vale
profile.role: Writer on contemporary art, curating and AI

bios.label: One line
bios.text: Nora Vale writes about how young artists live, curate and work with AI.

bios.label: Short, third person
bios.text: Nora Vale is a Berlin-based writer on contemporary art, curating and AI. She runs The Open Studio on Medium, where she writes about what young artists earn, how open calls really work and what AI changes in the studio. Her essays also appear in Atlas Review and Gallery Notes.

bios.label: Short, first person
bios.text: I write about contemporary art from the studio side: prices, open calls, residencies and, lately, what AI changes for artists and curators. My Medium publication The Open Studio has around 3,000 reads a month.

bios.label: CV line
bios.text: Writer and editor, The Open Studio (Medium), since 2024. Contributing writer, Atlas Review and Gallery Notes. Topics: art market for emerging artists, independent curating, AI and authorship.

bios.label: Speaker intro
bios.text: Nora Vale writes about the economy of young artists and the arrival of AI in curating. She has applied to forty open calls, curated two shows without an institution and now writes so that others do not have to learn it the hard way.
